input: Unfair discrimination and misrepresentation is a not a risk associated with An image upscaling system utilizes advanced algorithms to enhance and refine image quality, generating highly detailed and realistic facial features. It seeks to improve image clarity and resolution while maintaining the integrity of the source image.
